title: Enterprise Singapore government directory
appraisal: Primary current official record confirms IE/SPRING combined1April2018. Does not quantify merger savings.

title: Budget2018 support for firms
appraisal: Relevant original-publisher indexed passage inspected. Confirms harmonisation of CDG/GCP into EDG; not a full budget or savings appraisal.

title: Impact evaluation of EDG and EDG-I
publisher: Singapore economic survey; Ngoh Jia Hui and Jasmine Lee
appraisal: May2026 administrative-data fixed-effects evaluation. EDG2019–2022; other grants and firm/year effects controlled. Time-varying confounding and grant selection may remain; no merger counterfactual or fiscal return estimated.

title: EnterpriseSG annual media briefing2026
appraisal: Primary agency release. 2025 project counts and expected company revenue/cost benefits; not audited government savings. Average200k applies to relevant projects, not every supported enterprise.

title: Parliamentary reply on EDG broader impacts
appraisal: Recipients reported average200k annual company cost reductions; paragraph also calls savings estimated. No independent verification or agency-merger savings bridge. Same policy system, not independent corroboration of release.

title: Enterprise Singapore annual report2024–2025
appraisal: Original27-page report downloaded; relevant highlights inspected. Operating expenditure326.5m, manpower187.3m, other139.2m, grants305.5m, surplus2.5m. These are agency highlights, not all MSME support spending or an attributable merger saving. No audit opinion appraisal claimed.

title: OSMEP annual report2566/2023
appraisal: Original publisher indexed English passage inspected; full download/open timed out. FY2023 outputs119173 versus75500 target; expenditure5418423.72 versus5472000THB budget. Output and underspend not fiscal merger effect.

title: BDS programme results and FY2569 plans
appraisal: Primary programme promotion in Thai; translated/paraphrased here. Distinguish registrations,verified firms,proposals and headline beneficiaries. Agency economic-value claim has no counterfactual method here.260m support and300m FY2026 budget are funding,not savings. Provider network includes public specialist and academic organisations;2026 private-provider extension described as planned.

title: BDS SME application process
appraisal: Live programme workflow. Confirms common entry process; no measured burden or savings outcome.

title: Four years of the Ultra Micro holding
appraisal: Primary subsidiary account; relevant indexed formation passage inspected. Full page retrieval timed out. Holding formed13September2021; not three entities abolished. Self-report not independent merger evaluation.

title: BRI Q3 2025 results and Ultra Micro network
appraisal: 1035SenyuM outlets and34.5m active borrowers are operating stocks. Self-report; not newly included borrowers caused by holding or quantified net cost saving. General bank profit/funding claims not treated as holding-specific effects.

title: BRI customer journey and FY2024 UMi network
appraisal: Specialist client journey across PNM/Pegadaian/BRI. Different business models remain. No holding-specific net savings figure in inspected account.

title: SME Policy Index ASEAN2024
appraisal: Original517-page report downloaded; selected country/coordination passages inspected. Policy design/implementation/monitoring assessment,not causal impact or savings ranking. Malaysia described as advanced;Thailand coordination/data sharing still need improvement. Not a complete current2026 ministry map.

title: BRI annual report2025 full file
appraisal: Web extraction rejected over10MiB; local response wasHTML,not a validPDF. Do not claim full financial statements inspected or derive fiscal savings from this file.

title: KUSKOP detailed federal estimates 2027
appraisal: 2027 proposal with 2026 comparator; grants are not entity overhead. Operating estimates and amended development estimates have different labels.

title: KUSKOP internal audit annual report 2024
appraisal: Primary internal audit; findings have scope and date limits. Read management responses and Table89 closure status. Micro Connector counts conflict: Tables51 and54. Not a current whole-agency failure finding.

title: KUSKOP internal audit annual report 2025
appraisal: Audited reconciliation differs from initial reported counts. Certification application KPI is at least50%, not100%. Management says multiple grants can have different purposes. Responses are not independently verified completion here.

title: SME Bank integrated annual report 2025
appraisal: Audited financial statements distinguished from management performance statements. Bank-only and group amounts kept separate. Existing BPMB integration not new proposed reform savings.

title: AI Governance in Malaysia: Risks, Challenges and Pathways Forward
authors: Jun-E Tan; Rachel Gong; Khoo Wei Yang; Nik Syafiah Anis Nik Sharifulden
locator: Printed pp. 3–4, 26–27, 35, 39–41 and 47–48; executive summary vii–viii
appraisal: Original publisher PDF downloaded and relevant pages read locally. Qualitative 2024 interviews (21), roundtable (36) and desk research. No causal fiscal or closure evaluation. Ministry and industry reviewers acknowledged; not a current agency performance audit.
notes: KRI coordinates existing actors; our contribution extends that diagnosis to functional and fiscal review.
